scholarships.name: Sibling Concession

scholarshipNotes: All scholarship percentages apply to tuition fees only, not to hostel, mess, transport or other fees.
Only one scholarship can be held at a time; if a student qualifies for several, the highest one is applied.
New students apply within 30 days of admission through the Scholarship Cell; renewals are due by 30 November each year.

importantDates.title: Last date to pay odd semester exam fee
importantDates.note: Late fee of Rs 500 applies until 13 November; no registrations after that.

importantDates.title: KCET / COMEDK counselling and seat reporting (indicative)
importantDates.note: Exact dates are announced by the counselling authorities; report to Northgate within the window on your allotment order.
